column1: # Generated by tests/app/test_app.cpp (tests/run_all.sh). name<TAB>regex over DUMP lines joined by ;<TAB>-HBScript
title to first hand with the keyboard
the same path with mouse clicks only
a held confirm does not carry into the next screen
cursor answers on the same step as the press
cards slide in from the deck, then settle
relaxed pace: the rival takes over half a second to answer a call
fast pace from the options menu shortens the rival's pause
each floor has its own room
fold key gives up the blind
raise sizes: arrows and wheel step the amount, R commits it
all-in from the top raise size ends with a showdown or a fold
power keys spend a power and show the cut-in; pad button works too
a power that cannot be used is kept
pause opens over the table, blocks play, and resumes
pause during a cut-in keeps the hand intact
options from the pause menu and back to the table
quit to title keeps the run; continue resumes the same floor
winning a floor: result, rival's last word, next rival
losing a floor: continue halves the score, same rival
giving up records the score and returns to the title
mini-boss between floors: interlude header, short stacks, warden down
boss floor gets its own scene and music
beating the boss: ending, credits, score table, title again
credits also end by themselves
text stays inside its boxes on every screen
text fits on the lost-floor, options, pause and score screens
retake: CUT! reshoots the flop with a clapperboard cut-in
retake cannot be used before the flop
episode titles: versus screens and the floor-clear teaser
